input.quote: 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts. Prior to the [ * ], neither Ono or its Affiliates, nor Array or its Controlled Affiliates, shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory:
input.rationale: Section 8.2 imposes an exclusive-dealing/non-compete covenant on Ono (and its Affiliates), barring us from Commercializing any Competing Product in the Ono Territory for an open-ended period, extended after termination to the [ * ] anniversary, and enforced by an immediate Array termination right. That fails the fallback: the duration is not capped at 12 months (and the post-termination tail runs longer), and the only automatic relief is Array's own commercialization of a Competing Product, not any failure by Array to meet service levels or delivery dates. The supply arrangements in Article IX are not exclusivity — Array must supply Ono's requirements (p0495, p0510), but Ono expressly retains the right to Manufacture or engage a Subcontractor and to take a technology transfer (p0508), and the inbound exclusive licences in Section 2.1 run in our favour. We therefore take the preferred position and strike the Ono-side covenant, the post-termination restriction and Array's related termination right, while preserving Array's reciprocal restriction, which benefits us; the cross-reference in Section 14.2(a)(i) is conformed so no dangling reference to a termination under Section 8.2 remains.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

proposal.summary: Delete the exclusivity-of-efforts covenant insofar as it binds Ono (including the post-termination tail and Array's related termination right), retaining Array's non-compete for Ono's benefit.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an exclusivity/non-compete covenant binding Ono, so we have removed Ono and its Affiliates from Section 8.2, deleted the post-termination competing-product restriction on Ono and Array's related termination right, and conformed the cross-reference in Section 14.2(a)(i). Array's exclusivity undertaking, which benefits us, is preserved; if Array needs reciprocity we can discuss a narrow category-specific restriction capped at 12 months that lapses automatically on any Array supply failure.

ops.newText: neither Array nor its Controlled Affiliates shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory:

ops.oldText: In addition, in the event that Array terminates this Agreement for Ono's breach pursuant to Section 13.3 during the [ * ], or Ono exercises its right to terminate this Agreement "at will" pursuant to Section 13.2 during the Initial Royalty Term, then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
If Ono Commercializes a Competing Product in the Ono Territory during [ * ], Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.
